method: Independent numerical and analytic model checks, not renderer assertions.

checks.claim: Equilibrium surface-tension support divided by column area gives rise proportional to inverse radius.
Doubling radius doubles perimeter and quadruples cross-sectional area.

limitations: Assumes fixed liquid properties and contact angle. Widths are exaggerated; transient filling and meniscus volume are not simulated. Not a model of whole-tree water transport.
